name: Easy Chicken Risotto Casserole with Butternut Squash, Corn & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, 3-4 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer chicken to a large baking dish. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
1 tsp thyme, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and medium dice onion.

Return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes. Add cooked onion and garlic to the baking dish with the chicken along with butternut squash, rice, broth, cream, salt, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp butter, unsalted
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 (283 g) pkg frozen butternut squash, pieces
1 ½ cups arborio rice
2 ½ cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 cup heavy whipping cream
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cover baking dish tightly with aluminum foil and place in the preheated oven. Bake until the rice is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed, about 60 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to stand for 5 minutes.
When the rice is done, drain corn. Add to the baking dish, along with Parmesan and additional butter, then stir to combine the risotto.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (432 g) can whole kernel corn, canned
1 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide risotto between plates, then sprinkle with additional Parmesan and crushed red pepper (if desired). Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
¼ tsp crushed red pepper
